title: After an upstream refusal, this session switched to a fallback model
pending_title: The next start will use the configured model
unverified: Which model actually runs is only known from this session's next reply.
no_promise: No message is resent; the same request may be refused again.
terminal_hint: For a terminal session, type /model in Claude Code yourself; it may also change the default model for new sessions.
err_busy: This conversation is working, so nothing was closed. Try again once it stops.
err_unsupported: This session can't go back to the configured model from here. Use /model in its terminal.
err_nothing: This session no longer runs on a fallback model.
err_unknown: Persona can't tell right now which model this session uses or is configured with, so nothing was closed. Try again later.
err_outdated: personad on this computer is too old to go back to the configured model. Update it.
refusal_fallback: Claude Code switched from {from} to {to} on its own
refusal_session: Later turns of this session may keep using it
refusal_no_switch: The record doesn't say another model was used
